title: A Charlie Brown Christmas Live on Stage
seo_title: A Charlie Brown Christmas Live on Stage in Springfield
description: A Charlie Brown Christmas Live on Stage is a touring theater production in which Charlie Brown, Snoopy, Lucy, Linus and the Peanuts gang put on their own Christmas play and discover the true meaning of the season. Adapted from Charles M. Schulz's animated TV special, it features Vince Guaraldi's music and is meant for the whole family; all patrons need a ticket, regardless of age. It takes place Sunday, December 20, 2026 at 7:00 PM at Juanita K. Hammons Hall for the Performing Arts, 901 S. National Ave., Springfield, MO.
venue: Juanita K. Hammons Hall for the Performing Arts
